cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(XLICU LANGUAGES C CXX)
file(TO_CMAKE_PATH "${XL_DEPENDENCY_SOURCE}" XL_DEPENDENCY_SOURCE)
include(GNUInstallDirs)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
if(NOT EXISTS "${XL_DEPENDENCY_SOURCE}/source/common/unicode/utypes.h")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "XL_DEPENDENCY_SOURCE must name the locked ICU source root")
endif()
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden)
set(CMAKE_VISIBILITY_INLINES_HIDDEN ON)
set(XL_ICU_SOURCE "${XL_DEPENDENCY_SOURCE}/source")
file(GLOB XL_ICU_COMMON CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${XL_ICU_SOURCE}/common/*.cpp" "${XL_ICU_SOURCE}/common/*.c")
file(GLOB XL_ICU_I18N CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${XL_ICU_SOURCE}/i18n/*.cpp" "${XL_ICU_SOURCE}/i18n/*.c")
add_library(icuuc STATIC ${XL_ICU_COMMON} "${XL_ICU_SOURCE}/stubdata/stubdata.cpp")
add_library(icui18n STATIC ${XL_ICU_I18N})
foreach(XL_TARGET IN ITEMS icuuc icui18n)
  target_compile_definitions(${XL_TARGET} PUBLIC U_STATIC_IMPLEMENTATION U_LIB_SUFFIX_C_NAME=_xl
    PRIVATE UCONFIG_NO_FILE_IO=1 U_ENABLE_DYLOAD=0)
  target_include_directories(${XL_TARGET} PUBLIC "${XL_ICU_SOURCE}/common")
  target_link_libraries(${XL_TARGET} PRIVATE Threads::Threads)
  if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(${XL_TARGET} PRIVATE /utf-8)
  endif()
endforeach()
target_compile_definitions(icuuc PRIVATE U_COMMON_IMPLEMENTATION)
target_compile_definitions(icui18n PRIVATE U_I18N_IMPLEMENTATION)
target_include_directories(icui18n PRIVATE "${XL_ICU_SOURCE}/i18n")
target_link_libraries(icui18n PUBLIC icuuc)
install(TARGETS icuuc icui18n ARCHIVE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR})
install(DIRECTORY "${XL_ICU_SOURCE}/common/unicode/" "${XL_ICU_SOURCE}/i18n/unicode/"
  DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/unicode FILES_MATCHING PATTERN "*.h")
install(FILES "${XL_DEPENDENCY_SOURCE}/LICENSE" DESTINATION share/licenses/icu)
